title: Эвальд Васильевич Ильенков в воспоминаниях
annotation_policy: Manual research annotations for navigation and bibliography only. This file does not override generated manifest records and does not promote memoirs into the Ilyenkov author-original corpus.

items.title: О воспоминаниях (предисловие)
items.main_period: Retrospective framing from the twenty-five years after Ilyenkov's death.
major_events: Explains the memoir genre and the volume's purpose.
Frames Ilyenkov as a center of intellectual and personal memory.
Connects memoir writing with the need for a creative biography.
